name: The Fivefold Ministry
overview: The Fivefold Ministry, as outlined in Ephesians 4:11-13, reveals that Christ has given the church apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to equip believers and build up the body of Christ until unity and maturity in faith are achieved. This divine gifting fulfills the promise of the Spirit being poured out on all flesh, empowering believers to prophesy and minister (Joel 2:28; Acts 15:32). The ministry serves the purpose of perfecting the saints and fostering spiritual growth, as believers are encouraged to worship and edify one another with psalms and hymns, reflecting a Christ-centered community life (Ephesians 4:12, 5:19).
